section_summary.extract_value: This section reports results of independent samples t-tests comparing Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) factor scores between Malay and Chinese participants (n=589). No significant differences were found between the two ethnic groups on either General Body Appreciation or Body Image Investment factor scores. The study appears to be a single cross-cultural comparison examining BAS responses across ethnic groups.
